description: This file contains validation functions for scheduler cell configuration messages in a 5G NR RAN context, including checks for PDCCH, RACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, SIB1, and paging configurations, as well as overall cell configuration validation.

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg_common
methods.description: Validates the PDCCH configuration search spaces and coreset IDs within the cell configuration message.

methods.name: validate_rach_cfg_common
methods.description: Validates RACH configuration, including PRACH index, root sequence, and zero correlation zone, ensuring compatibility with band and duplex mode.

methods.name: validade_pusch_td_res_list
methods.description: Validates the PUSCH time domain resource list for correct sorting and subset relations, including TDD pattern compliance.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg_common
methods.description: Validates the PUSCH configuration list if present.

methods.name: validate_sib1_cfg
methods.description: Validates SIB1 configuration including PRBS size, modulation, and resource allocation.

methods.name: validate_sched_cell_configuration_request_message
methods.description: Main validation function for the entire cell configuration message, calling specific validation routines for each parameter.
